derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3346 (μετατίθημι);

occurrences.text: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
